views.name: v_customer_consumption
views.create_sql: /* Views thu cong cho database debit_card_specializing (Paper V-SQL style) */ /* 1. View ket hop thong tin khach hang va muc tieu thu yearmonth */ CREATE VIEW v_customer_consumption AS SELECT customers.CustomerID AS customer_id, customers.Segment AS customer_segment, customers.Currency AS currency, yearmonth.Date AS year_month, yearmonth.Consumption AS consumption FROM customers LEFT JOIN yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID

views.name: v_transaction_details
views.create_sql: /* 2. View ket hop thong tin giao dich, tram xang va san pham */ CREATE VIEW v_transaction_details AS SELECT transactions_1k.TransactionID AS transaction_id, transactions_1k.Date AS transaction_date, transactions_1k.Time AS transaction_time, transactions_1k.CustomerID AS customer_id, transactions_1k.CardID AS card_id, transactions_1k.GasStationID AS gas_station_id, transactions_1k.ProductID AS product_id, transactions_1k.Amount AS amount, transactions_1k.Price AS price, gasstations.Country AS station_country, gasstations.Segment AS station_segment, gasstations.ChainID AS station_chain_id, products.Description AS product_description FROM transactions_1k LEFT JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID LEFT JOIN products ON transactions_1k.ProductID = products.ProductID
